ProductTitle: Batiste Dry Shampoo Fresh, Breezy Citrus Scent, Refreshes Hair Without Drying, 4.23 oz (Pack of 6)
ReviewTitle: Love this dry shampoo. For this price, you can’t beat the quality.
ReviewContent: I have tried many dry shampoo’s, and Batiste is by far my favorite. This (the original) is my favorite scent although all their scents are great. It does an incredible job of soaking up oil and blending into the hair. No white residue and not a drop of oil after a few sprays on your roots. For reference, I’m a 35 year old Caucasian female with very thick, coarse hair (about 1-2 inches past the shoulder in length) that is naturally medium brown in color, although I do add blonde highlights every eight weeks or so. I only wash my hair once a week, and you would never guess that by looking at my hair on day seven. This dry shampoo also helps perk your blow out back up- it erases any creases that are caused when I clip back my hair while washing my face/brushing my teeth. I pin my hair back with a clip and use a shower cap when showering to keep my hair dry. I once had a boyfriend tell me that my hair was always “on point”, and it was shocking to him when he found out that I only wash it once weekly. He said I had the best smelling hair he had ever encountered as well. Batiste can be pricy when you buy a single can in the drugstore, but I always buy in bulk on Amazon. For the prices on here, you can’t beat the quality. This specific seller was very fast with shipping and the product was authentic.  I received my product tightly packed together in clear plastic. No issues or concerns.

ProductTitle: Batiste Dry Shampoo Fresh, Breezy Citrus Scent, Refreshes Hair Without Drying, 4.23 oz (Pack of 6)
ReviewTitle: Licensed cosmetologist, and this is my favorite dry shampoo.
ReviewContent: I am a licensed cosmetologist. I have tried so many different brands and kinds of dry shampoo. Professional and not. Yet this one, is the one I keep coming back to. It has a good smell, and it works well! It’s a decent price, and good quality for the price. Yes, there are better dry shampoos out there, but they have a much higher price point. And comparatively, I love this shampoo and it works as well as I need it to! It’s not worth paying a lot more for a slightly better product. I also use it way more often than I should be… so price is kind of a big deal for me. It’s good for oily hair, as well as adding extra body to your hair. It’s great. Sometimes leaves some white spots, but it’s avoidable, and easy enough to rub them out or hide them with a comb or brush and sometimes a little water. Other than that, I have no complaints.

I did create a ranking- and none of the drug store versions worked until I found Batiste. I only like fresh and original scent, everything else is too overpowering. And I can often find discounted at TJMaxx/Marshalls but then I found the six set on Amazon and have never looked back. Life long loyal customer. If you have been struggling with greasy/flat hair, start here. I’m sure you won’t regret it. I can now find at least one bottle in all my friends/family bathrooms now! Must shake well and don’t spray too close.

ReviewContent: The product itself is great, but very unhappy with this particular purchase as I didn’t realize I needed to be a mathematician to know what I would be receiving.  The item title and description needs to be updated as it is NOT 6.73 ounces!  It is only 4.23 ounces.  The cans I received are different looking than pictures on Amazon.  Which is fine, designs change all the time, but should still receive what ordered ounces wise.  The cans I received do not even show ounces, only 200ml and 120g printed on bottom of cans.  The other sneaky thing is the Amazon title does show 6.73 ounces plus 200ml, so they do not match, but I did not realize I needed to be a math wiz to know such.  In addition all the pictures on Amazon show “6.73 ounces.”  Even the 59 cents per ounce that Amazon touted is wrong because that was a 6.73 ounces calculation, when done as 4.23 ounces it is actually 94 cents per ounce.  Anyway contemplating whether to return or keep as a lesson learned to cross check ALL the math/ounces/ml/g to make sure they match BEFORE purchasing.  20240421
